_notes: Names and muscles stay nominative: 'X – technika wykonania' (the usual Polish title shape, e.g. Decathlon/mediaexpert atlas) instead of 'Jak wykonać X', which breaks on feminine names like 'Deska'; muscle pages are '{muscle}: ćwiczenia' because 'Ćwiczenia na klatkę…' needs the accusative. Level reads 'poziom średni/początkujący/zaawansowany' (the app's adjectives agree with 'poziom'). Counts use 'Liczba ćwiczeń: {n}' / 'Ćwiczenia: {n}', correct for any n. Headings follow Cora's and gymkee's Polish exercise pages ('Mięśnie pracujące', 'Serie i powtórzenia według celu', 'Przerwa'); 'Atlas ćwiczeń' is the Polish term for an exercise library; 'ty' register as on the site. Muscle pages off (owner 2026-10-26: skip low-confidence pages; the safe "{muscle}: ..." form reads stiffly).
